summary: Verified public Bendita storefront, responsive navigation, empty cart, admin CRUD/category flows, and backend persistence.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned TEST-prefixed API product/category; browser flow created a QA product/category and exercised deletion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public CRUD API and primary desktop/mobile UI flows are covered. Image upload against external object storage was not exercised because it requires a binary file and third-party storage integration.
rca of the issue: No application defects reproduced. The browser script's final DOM error selector used malformed nested quotes, causing a Page.evaluate syntax error after all functional assertions had passed; this is a test-script-only issue.
